A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed<ref name="EiR" /> on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]<ref name="EiR" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The racing season presented in the [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]'' must have taken place during this year due to the appearances of [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the PC and [[Wikipedia:Nintendo 64|Nintendo 64]] versions of the game, which correspond to ''The Phantom Menace''.</ref> The course had a rocky surface, and contained several sharp turns and long straightaways, the latter which served as good opportunities for pilots to use their thrusters. The track also moved through a sizable [[Methane/Legends|methane]] [[Methane lake|lake]], which was covered in a [[Color/Legends|green]] haze. The [[Vulptereen/Legends|Vulptereen]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Dud Bolt/Legends|Dud Bolt]] was favored here, and would race against other pilots using his [[Vulptereen 327/Legends|Vulptereen 327]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. It was one of five courses available at the start of the game.<ref name="EiR" />
